faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about plans, billing, and support.

upgrade.question: How can I upgrade?
upgrade.answer: You can upgrade anytime from your workspace settings. Changes apply to your next billing cycle, and your team keeps access to new features immediately after upgrading.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. You can cancel your plan at any time. You’ll retain access until the end of your current billing period, with no long-term contracts on Starter or Growth.

trial.question: Do you offer free trials?
trial.answer: We offer a free trial so you can explore the workspace before committing. Start with Get Started to create your account and evaluate core features.

enterprise.question: Do you support enterprise deployments?
enterprise.answer: Yes. Enterprise plans include dedicated support, custom integrations, SLA options, and security requirements tailored to larger organizations.

support.question: How do I contact support?
support.answer: Email support is included on every plan. Growth includes priority support, and Enterprise customers get a dedicated support channel. You can also reach sales at sales@whats-auto.com.

content.p1: Automate outbound campaigns, order updates, and support replies without manual copy-paste. Connect your WhatsApp Business account once and let workflows handle the rest.
content.p2: Trigger messages from events in your stack - new orders, abandoned carts, ticket updates - and keep every conversation on-brand with templates you control.
content.highlight1: Broadcast and drip campaigns with delivery tracking
content.highlight2: Inbound message routing to the right team or bot

content.p1: Draft contextual replies in seconds using conversation history and your knowledge base. Agents stay in control - approve, edit, or send with one tap.
content.p2: Smart Replies learns your tone over time and surfaces the best suggestions for FAQs, pricing questions, and follow-ups.
content.highlight2: Multilingual suggestions for EN and HI
content.highlight3: Confidence scores so teams trust every suggestion

content.p1: Connect Shopify to Whats-Auto and turn store events into timely WhatsApp messages - order confirmations, shipping updates, and win-back nudges.
content.step1: Install the Whats-Auto app from Shopify and authorize your store
content.step2: Choose which order and customer events should trigger messages
content.step3: Map template variables to Shopify fields like order ID and tracking URL
content.p2: Changes sync in real time so customers always get accurate status updates on the channel they actually read.

content.p1: Send instant payment receipts and failed-payment reminders over WhatsApp when Razorpay webhooks fire - no manual follow-ups required.
content.step1: Add your Razorpay webhook URL in the Razorpay dashboard
content.step2: Select payment captured, failed, and refund events in Whats-Auto
content.step3: Customize message templates per event with amount and invoice links
content.p2: Reduce support load and improve collection rates with automated, personalized payment notifications.
